name: Progress M-34
about: Progress M-34 (1997-014A), a crewed vehicle (Progress M), launched 1997 Apr  6. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1997 May  6), held fixed
